Betalbatim · a short walk from the Arabian Sea · Wok | Steam | Draught

Drinks menu · craft taps & bottled beer · whisky & vodka · cocktails · zero proof · coffee

Three craft taps brewed up the coast, plus Kings and Budweiser by the bottle. Single malts, blended Scotch and an Irish whiskey, four vodkas, eight cocktails built around feni, kokum, soju and lemongrass, fresh zero-proof coolers and brewed coffee, poured at the bar all day.
